items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Max Jones, reporter of the English Jazz journal "Melody Maker" had called me in an article "The man from the Trois Mailletz".

ctx.x: Lily who really could not pull herself together, went back to bed and Ismay and myself started to wash the dishes!!!!

I was going through the same routine of leaving the club to do galas and concerts and coming back again at the Trois Mailletz. Max Jones, reporter of the English Jazz journal "Melody Maker" had called me in an article "The man from the Trois Mailletz". Many people started to believe that it was my club. But it was not and the 15th of June 1960, Madame Calvé, the owner of the place announced to me that my service would no longer required after the 15th last of that month.
She had the violinist Stephane Grappelli as another attraction since
